name: @oh-my-pi/desktop
description: OMP Desktop app — Electron shell over the omp coding agent (RPC sidecar)
author: OMP contributors

scripts.electron:compile: bun build ./electron/main.ts --outfile ./dist-electron/main.js --target node --format esm --external electron && bun build ./electron/preload.ts --outfile ./dist-electron/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.electron:dev: bun run build && bun run electron:compile && electron .
scripts.electron:build: bun run build && bun run electron:compile && electron-builder
scripts.e2e: bun run build && bun run electron:compile && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.bundle: bun run sidecar && bun run electron:build
